eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 15 · Relationship Queries

code:
-- SELECT list: returns child records
SELECT Name,
  (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts)
FROM Account

-- WHERE clause: filters only
SELECT Name FROM Account
WHERE Id IN (
  SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity)
caption: Same parentheses, completely different job.

code:
SELECT Name,
  (SELECT LastName, Title
   FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName)
FROM Account
WHERE Id IN (
  SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity
  WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won')
caption: Won accounts, each with its contacts.

subtitle: Searching across objects instead of querying one.
